fields.brand: Card brand, upper case. Its code is its index in brands, plus 1.
fields.high: Highest first 12 PAN digits in the range.
fields.low: Lowest first 12 PAN digits in the range.
fields.slot: Leaf index in the Merkle tree.

tree.leaf: low + high·2^40 + country·2^80 + type·2^90 + brand·2^92 + commercial·2^100 + 2^101; 0 if empty. type: credit 1, debit 2, prepaid 3.
tree.node: Poseidon2 (noir-lang/poseidon v0.3.0, t = 4) of the left and right child.
